changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[FieldDetails] ( @ObjectType varchar(50), @ObjectID int, @id int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT CASE WHEN T.AllowAllValue = 1 AND F.[Value] = '0' THEN CAST(T.AllowAllLabel AS nvarchar(MAX)) WHEN F.FormattedValue IS NOT NULL THEN F.FormattedValue WHEN T.DefaultFormattedValue IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(T .DefaultFormattedValue AS nvarchar(MAX)) ELSE NULL END AS FormattedValue, T.ID as FieldTypeID, COALESCE (F.Value, T.DefaultValue) AS Value FROM dbo.FieldType AS T LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Field AS F ON f.objecttype = @ObjectType and f.objectid = @ObjectID and F.FieldTypeID = T.ID WHERE t.id = @id and (F.Value IS NOT NULL OR T.DefaultValue IS NOT NULL OR T.ShowIfEmpty = 1 ) )
